title: Our American Story: Spotlight on Chris Mills
summary: Watch as Coca-Cola Consolidated Teammate Chris Mills shares his personal memories, connections and experiences with the Coca-Cola brand.
body_markdown:
Every Teammate has a story and many of those stories are woven into the moments that define America.


Watch as Coca-Cola Consolidated Teammate Chris Mills shares his personal memories, connections and experiences with the Coca-Cola brand. From family traditions to career journeys, these reflections show how Coca-Cola has long been part of the moments that bring Americans together. ⬇️
